title: Quality & Moat Screen — S&P/TSX 60 constituents
universe_text: Universe as of 2026-10-31: S&P/TSX 60 constituents from Claude's knowledge of the 2025/26 index composition (not from an index file — verify membership), excluding Shopify and Thomson Reuters, which are covered in the Nasdaq-100 ∪ S&P 500 workbook. GICS sector and sub-industry assigned by hand.
caveat: CAVEAT: This is a qualitative screen, not investment advice and not a valuation. Scores are judgements based on each company's business model and public knowledge as of November 2026; they can be wrong or out of date, and a PASS says nothing about whether the share price is attractive. Verify before acting.
how_produced: v4.4: universe added after the superinvestor cross-check (Canadian railways, Brookfield, Restaurant Brands were missing). All Phase 1–3 inputs pre-scored by Claude from public knowledge as of November 2026 with the v4.3 rubrics; bank / insurer / holding estimates (CET1, LICAT, combined ratio, NAV) are Claude estimates — verify.
sources: Sources: Claude's knowledge of the S&P/TSX 60 composition and company reports (to be verified); market data via fetch_market_data.py (Yahoo Finance).
fx_note: Financial statement values are in the reporting currency (several Canadian companies report in USD); market cap is converted into that currency by the fetcher so yields are like-for-like.
